sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Constant %vct feeling in nose, which no
amount of blowing will relieve. Discharge thick, pus-
like, streaked with blood. Post-nasal catarrh of puberty.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Semi-fluid evacuation of the bowels next morning, having been
somewhat constipated,''. — Some weeks after proving, suffered from consti¬
pation, an atonic condition of the bowels and rectum,'*. — Was costive
when commencing proving; had two natural stools from yesterday’s medi¬
cine (third day),'.

Urinary Organs, — [40.] A dull aching in kidneys (third day),'. —
The bladder became sore to pressure (third day),'. — Urine still increased
in flow, with burning along the urethi’a when micturating (third day),'. —
Urine continued in increased flow for more than a week, as did the burn¬
ing in the urethra (after three days),'. — Urine clear, passed more frequently
(second day),'. — Urine actively acid, as shown by litmus; no cloud on boil¬
ing; threw down a sediment with acid, ammonia, and argent, nitri-

cum and nitric acid, when boiled ; the next day after the dose it was alka¬
line, as shown by litmus, and only precipitated with argent, nitricum ;
slightly cloudy, with caloric ; unloaded, but increased in quantity,'*.

Sexual Organs. — Sexual orgasm (second night),'. — Erythismus of
the sexual system, almost a satyriasis; a slight varicocele of longstanding
was apparently cured (some weeks after proving) ; this condition was suc¬
ceeded by a corresponding depression of sexual function, approaching ira-
potency, after mouths of time returning to the normal condition,'*.

JtespiJ’Otory Organs. — In the morning, a cough seemed to come
from deep iu the chest, with soreness throughout the chest (third day),'.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Slight feeling of constriction, which passed from above down
through the chest, followed the wet feeling in trachea and bronchia (first
day),'.

PENTHORUM— PERSICA.

Pulse, — [50.] Pulse regular, at 58 (first day),*.

Heck fl'ud Pack. — Aching through basilar region, from back to
front, — The aching in sacral region reappeared, but subsided as the medi¬
cine was eliminated,'*. — Aching in sacrum and in sacro-iliac symphysis,
with the itching of anus, haemorrhoids,'!. — (When commencing the prov¬
ing, had heat and soreness in the sacrum, with a dull, heavy headache ;
this was cured), (third day),*.

Ejctverniiies, — Arm went to sleep (numb), (second night),*. — Hand
felt swollen (second night),*. — A trembling feeling of legs for several days,
with soreness of knees,*. — While on the lounge the muscles of the leg were
suddenly contracted, jerking up the foot as in stepping; in a moment the
right one performed the same manoeuvre (third day),*.

Skin, — A long-cured impetiginous eczema reappeared on both legs,'*. —
[60.] A few hot prickings in the skin (second and third days),*. — Itching
of face and forehead,**. — The itchings repeated themselves (third day),*.

Sleep and Fevev. — Fantastic dreams (second night),*. — Voluptuous
dreams and increased sexual desire, sympathetic with urinary excitement,**.
— A very few cold chills rushed in succession up the spinal column (first
day),*.

PERSICA.
